mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_service_stats (tenant_id, service_id, service_name, service_category, stat_date, order_count, total_quantity, total_revenue, avg_price, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{serviceId}, #{serviceName}, #{serviceCategory}, #{statDate}, #{orderCount}, #{totalQuantity}, #{totalRevenue}, #{avgPrice}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE service_name = #{serviceName}, service_category = #{serviceCategory}, order_count = #{orderCount}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, total_revenue = #{totalRevenue}, avg_price = #{avgPrice}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT service_id as serviceId, service_name as serviceName, service_category as serviceCategory, SUM(order_count) as orderCount, SUM(total_quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(total_revenue) as totalRevenue, CASE WHEN SUM(total_quantity) > 0 THEN SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity) ELSE 0 END as avgPrice FROM daily_service_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY service_id, service_name, service_category ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT service_id as serviceId, service_name as serviceName, service_category as serviceCategory, SUM(total_revenue) as totalRevenue, SUM(order_count) as orderCount FROM daily_service_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY service_id, service_name, service_category ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_service_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
